annotations.title: Put a document on the paired editor's canvas

description: Replaces the document in the person's open editor with the one given. It is NOT saved: the person sees the change, can undo it, and saves it themselves. The document is validated first and refused with the problems if it does not parse. Needs an MCP key that can edit.

note.description: What changed, shown to the person in the editor
